Title: Two Plus Cafe soft play, Acton
Address: Two Plus Cafe, Unit 16, Edison Court, Warple Way, Acton
DaysOfWeek: Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri, Sat, Sun
ScheduleText: 1-hour sessions on the hour: Mon–Sat first session 8:00 (8:00 and 9:00 off-peak, pre-book only), Sun from 10:00; last session 17:00. May close 12:00–15:00 at weekends for private parties
PriceText: 60 minutes: under 2s £7.90, 2–4 £11.40, 5–6 £13.40; off-peak (Mon–Fri 8:00, 9:00) £6.90 / £9.40 / £11.40. Two adults free, extra adult £4.40
Description: Café with a separate soft play room for 6 months to 6 years: trampolines, ball pits, slides, role-play houses. Max 25 children a session, 5 places kept for walk-ins; book online or arrive 15–20 minutes early. Socks for children and adults; café food only. Free street parking on Warple Way
NeedsInfo: Read on twopluscafe.com 1 Nov 2026 (page shows the 30 Oct 2026 Halloween party). Home page footer says last session 16:00 and soft play from 9:00; soft play page says first 8:00, last 17:00. Weekend 12–3 closures announced on Instagram @twoplus.cafe
